시편 33:1.content: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

시편 33:2.content: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

시편 33:3.content: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

시편 33:4.content: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.

시편 33:5.content: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

시편 33:6.content: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

시편 33:7.content: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

시편 33:8.content: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

시편 33:9.content: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

시편 33:10.content: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

시편 33:11.content: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

시편 33:12.content: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

시편 33:13.content: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

시편 33:14.content: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

시편 33:15.content: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

시편 33:16.content: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

시편 33:17.content: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

시편 33:18.content: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

시편 33:19.content: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

시편 33:20.content: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

시편 33:21.content: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

시편 33:22.content: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
